t: 佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在西罗马帝国皇帝罗马元老院的支持下成为了皇帝;他迫使他的前任瓦伦蒂安三…
te: Petronius Maximus becomes, with support of the Roman Senate, emperor of the Western Roman Empire; he forces Licinia Eud…
dz: 佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在西罗马帝国皇帝罗马元老院的支持下成为了皇帝;他迫使他的前任瓦伦蒂安三世的遗孀利西尼亚·欧多克西亚嫁给他.
de: Petronius Maximus becomes, with support of the Roman Senate, emperor of the Western Roman Empire; he forces Licinia Eudoxia, the widow of his predecessor, Valentinian III, to marry him.

t: 皇帝佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在逃离罗马时被愤怒的暴徒用石头砸死.
te: Emperor Petronius Maximus is stoned to death by an angry mob while fleeing Rome.
dz: 皇帝佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在逃离罗马时被愤怒的暴徒用石头砸死.
de: Emperor Petronius Maximus is stoned to death by an angry mob while fleeing Rome.

t: 万道尔人进入罗马,并掠夺了这座城市两周.
te: Vandals enter Rome, and plunder the city for two weeks.
dz: 罗马的萨克:万道尔人进入罗马,并掠夺了这座城市两周.
de: Sack of Rome: Vandals enter Rome, and plunder the city for two weeks.

t: 年长的贵族阿维图斯被哥特式国王特奥德里克二世在图卢兹所封为罗马皇帝.
te: The elderly noble Avitus is proclaimed Roman emperor by Gothic king Theoderic II in Toulouse.
dz: 年长的贵族阿维图斯被哥特式国王特奥德里克二世在图卢兹所封为罗马皇帝.
de: The elderly noble Avitus is proclaimed Roman emperor by Gothic king Theoderic II in Toulouse.

t: 阿维图斯皇帝以一支高利克军队入意大利并巩固他的权力.
te: Emperor Avitus enters Italy with a Gallic army and consolidates his power.
dz: 阿维图斯皇帝以一支高利克军队入意大利并巩固他的权力.
de: Emperor Avitus enters Italy with a Gallic army and consolidates his power.
